title: Stop custom command widgets showing raw JSON for an empty text
body:
Fixes #15346

**Cause:** `CustomCommandModule.update()` used `data.text || raw`, so a valid Waybar-style line with an empty `"text"` fell back to the raw output and the bar painted the whole JSON string. A JSON line with no `text` key did the same.

**Change:** `Util.parseModuleJson()` now only treats a JSON *object* as JSON (a plain number or quoted string stays plain text) and marks plain output with `plain: true`. The custom command widget uses the parsed JSON as-is, so an empty or missing `text` leaves the widget empty, and only plain output keeps the raw line. `BarIndicator`/`Reminder` read `count` and `tooltip` and are unaffected.

**Testing:**
- `bash test/shell.d/bar-test.sh`: passes (93 checks), now including source assertions for the new fallback rule and the plain-output marker.
- `bash test/shell.d/qml-text-format-test.sh`: passes.
- `bash test/shell.d/runtime-smoke-test.sh`: fails at "each widget registers its IPC handler once per screen (saw 4 for 2 screen(s))" identically on a clean `origin/quattro` worktree, so it is unrelated to this change.
- Not tested: rendering the widget with a stubbed process; the checks above are source assertions plus the shell loading the bar.
